name: Cell-Type Percolation
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Whether a cell type is one connected mass or many islands.
citation: Stauffer, D. & Aharony, A. (1994). Introduction to Percolation Theory, 2nd ed. Taylor & Francis. Gower, J. C. & Ross, G. J. S. (1969). Minimum spanning trees and single linkage cluster analysis. Applied Statistics 18(1), 54-64.

params.name: field
params.label: Grouping column
params.help: Selects the annotation used to define the groups.

params.name: min_cells
params.label: Minimum cells per category
params.help: Categories with fewer placed cells than this are not scored and appear unpainted (grey) on the map.

params.name: giant_frac
params.label: Giant-component fraction
params.help: Sets the fraction of a group that must belong to its largest connected patch to define the percolation threshold r*.

params.name: n_sims
params.label: Null draws
params.help: Sets the number of random groups used for comparison. More draws provide a more precise comparison but increase runtime; 0 disables the null results and grey band.

params.name: link_scale
params.label: Patch-map link radius
params.help: Sets the distance used to define map patches. Cells are colored by patch size at that distance; the plot and r* are unchanged.

params.name: max_per_type
params.label: Maximum cells per category
params.help: Limits runtime by reproducibly subsampling larger categories. Subsampling may change the map and threshold results.
